title: One-shot iterator allocation
spec: Implement allocate(records, budget). records is any iterable of (name, weight) pairs with unique string names and non-negative integer weights; it may be a one-shot iterator such as a generator and must be consumed only once. budget is a non-negative integer. Return a dictionary mapping every name to budget * weight // total, where total is the sum of all weights. When total is zero, every name maps to 0.
target_defect: records is iterated twice, so a generator input yields an empty result after the total is computed.
author_rationale: Simplify the allocation into one comprehension and avoid copying the input.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it. Designed around omissions, cross-function effects and edge cases stated in the contract. Not a natural pull request; correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks.
